roles.functionStatement: Contain and control wildland fire safely with ground tactics, keeping crews within the safety margins of observed fire behaviour.

shown.label: Wildland fire position qualifications under the interagency standard (e.g., firefighter, burn boss, incident commander types)

instruments.label: Secretarial Order 3448 establishing the U.S. Wildland Fire Service
USWFS-USFS aligned federal wildland fire qualification standards (IQCS 2026 Transition Plan)

bands.indicativeBand: GS-3 to GS-5 (entry); GS-6 to GS-7 (journey)

majorDuties.duty: Suppress wildland fire safely with ground tactics and resources

tasks.statement: Construct fireline with hand tools or equipment to the specified width and depth while keeping escape routes and safety zones current
Mop up heat along the control line until the perimeter meets the incident's containment standard
Execute a firing operation that removes fuel between the control line and the fire under the firing boss's direction

majorDuties.duty: Operate chainsaws and other power equipment safely in field conditions

tasks.statement: Fell trees with a chainsaw within the operator's certification limits, planning the face cut, hinge and escape route from the tree's size-up
Inspect a chainsaw before use for chain brake, chain catcher, throttle lock and chain condition, removing a defective saw from service
Decline to fell a tree that exceeds the operator's qualification or shows unmanageable defects, choosing an alternative such as leaving, blasting or mechanical felling

majorDuties.duty: Use and maintain hand tools safely for field work

tasks.statement: Use hand tools such as grubbing hoes, axes, crosscut saws and shovels for vegetation, trail and restoration work with safe spacing and body position
Restore dull or damaged hand tools to safe working condition by sharpening, rehafting or replacing parts to the tool standard

majorDuties.duty: Conduct prescribed fire from burn planning through ignition, holding and evaluation

tasks.statement: Ignite a prescribed fire unit with hand-held devices following the firing pattern and the firing boss's direction
Check holding resources, equipment and crew briefing completion against the burn plan before ignition begins

majorDuties.duty: Predict fire behaviour from fuels, weather and topography for operations and planning

tasks.statement: Calculate fuel moisture and fire danger indices from on-site fire weather observations for an operational period

majorDuties.duty: Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments

tasks.statement: Stop field work when hazards change beyond the controls in the job hazard analysis, re-briefing the crew before work resumes
Recognize early heat illness or smoke exposure symptoms in crew members, removing affected people from exposure and starting care

majorDuties.duty: Communicate during field emergencies and report incidents

tasks.statement: Communicate an emergency to dispatch by radio, satellite device or beacon, giving location, nature of the emergency and resources needed in the required format
Test field radios and satellite devices for a work area before deployment, programming channels and confirming coverage at key locations

majorDuties.duty: Drive and operate field vehicles safely on unpaved roads and off road

tasks.statement: Drive a four-wheel-drive vehicle on unpaved and off-road routes, selecting gear, speed and line for mud, sand, snow, rock and water crossings

majorDuties.duty: Assess tree risk and structural condition

tasks.statement: Assess hazard trees around a field work site or crew area before work starts, flagging trees that need removal or an exclusion zone

majorDuties.duty: Maintain and repair field equipment and vehicles

tasks.statement: Perform scheduled maintenance on field equipment and vehicles to the manufacturer's or program's schedule, recording each service

majorDuties.duty: Stabilize burned areas after wildfire from field assessment of burn severity and values at risk

tasks.statement: Implement emergency stabilization treatments such as mulching, seeding and drainage on burned slopes to the treatment prescription

majorDuties.duty: Provide first aid and emergency medical care in remote field settings

tasks.statement: Assess an injured or ill person in a remote location with a structured patient assessment, giving first aid within the scope of training

majorDuties.duty: Navigate and travel safely in remote terrain with and without digital aids

tasks.statement: Recover position and continue safely when satellite positioning is degraded or a device fails, switching to map, compass and terrain association

roles.functionStatement: Reduce wildfire hazard and restore fire-adapted conditions through fuels treatments and prescribed fire executed within prescription and air-quality limits.

shown.label: Wildland fire position qualifications under the interagency standard (e.g., firefighter, burn boss, incident commander types)

instruments.label: USWFS-USFS aligned federal wildland fire qualification standards (IQCS 2026 Transition Plan)

majorDuties.duty: Conduct prescribed fire from burn planning through ignition, holding and evaluation

tasks.statement: Write a burn plan with objectives, prescription parameters, holding and contingency actions for a prescribed fire unit
Monitor fire behaviour, weather and smoke during a burn against the prescription, reporting values outside it to the burn boss
Ignite a prescribed fire unit with hand-held devices following the firing pattern and the firing boss's direction
Check holding resources, equipment and crew briefing completion against the burn plan before ignition begins
Evaluate fire effects on monitoring plots against burn objectives, recording outcomes that inform the next burn plan

majorDuties.duty: Design fuels treatments that reduce wildfire hazard and verify their effects in the field

tasks.statement: Assess fuels in a planning area with standard fuel models and field sampling to set treatment priorities
Supervise mechanical or hand fuels treatments to the prescription's residual fuel and canopy specifications
Verify a remotely sensed fuels map in the field, correcting fuel-model assignments that misrepresent observed conditions
Evaluate fuels treatment effectiveness by re-measuring fuels and modelling fire behaviour after treatment

majorDuties.duty: Plan smoke management for prescribed and managed fire within air quality requirements

tasks.statement: Prepare the smoke management section of a burn plan, identifying sensitive receptors, dispersion limits and contingency actions
Compare a smoke dispersion forecast with monitor and observer data during a burn, recommending holding or stopping ignition when the forecast fails

majorDuties.duty: Predict fire behaviour from fuels, weather and topography for operations and planning

tasks.statement: Predict fire spread, intensity and spotting for an operational period from fuels, weather and topography, stating assumptions

majorDuties.duty: Sample and assess vegetation using standardized field protocols

tasks.statement: Establish vegetation monitoring plots to protocol and record species composition, cover and density within the program's measurement-quality objectives

majorDuties.duty: Plan and run field campaigns and remote logistics

tasks.statement: Schedule a field campaign against phenology, flow, tide or weather windows so that each protocol's sampling window is met
Secure access permissions for field sites from landowners and land managers before the season, recording the conditions of access for crews

majorDuties.duty: Operate and supervise uncrewed and automated field systems

tasks.statement: Operate an uncrewed aerial ignition system under the firing boss's direction, changing ignition lines as fire behaviour and holding capacity change

majorDuties.duty: Read site history and reference conditions from landscape evidence

tasks.statement: Interpret fire scars, stumps, soil horizons and legacy structures at a site to reconstruct its disturbance and land-use history

majorDuties.duty: Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments

tasks.statement: Brief a field crew on the day's site hazards, escape routes, safety zones and communication plan before work begins

majorDuties.duty: Lead field crews and transfer field judgment to novices

tasks.statement: Lead a small crew through a field day, matching tasks to skill and checking novice work early and often

majorDuties.duty: Operate chainsaws and other power equipment safely in field conditions

tasks.statement: Fell trees with a chainsaw within the operator's certification limits, planning the face cut, hinge and escape route from the tree's size-up

majorDuties.duty: Ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field

tasks.statement: Code the likely field cause of each mismatch between a remote product and field observation, such as timing, mixed pixels, hidden understory or location error

majorDuties.duty: Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings

tasks.statement: Exercise stop-work authority when field, facility or incident conditions exceed the stated safety limits of the assignment
